message: No detected input validation: The data loading code in data_loader.py and experimental_data.py reads files and parses values with int() but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, range guards, or structural validation on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: All data is read from local file paths (e.g., ./data/processed/, ./data/TTD/) with no remote fetching, so there is no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check of any remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: Labels are hardcoded as 1 (positive) or 0 (negative) during loading with no validation against an expected set, distribution comparison, or label-noise detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the training samples before or after loading.

No detected model integrity verification: The code trains models from scratch using scikit-learn and XGBoost; no pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded, and no hash/signature verification is performed anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected label distribution validation: The code uses RandomUnderSampler with a fixed strategy and stratified split but never explicitly validates or checks the label distribution before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense implemented anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any robustness stress tests are present in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is performed, there is no held-out test set isolated from hyperparameter tuning (GridSearchCV uses the same pool), no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and only a single metric (roc_auc) is used without independent verification.
No detected input sanitization: The data loading code simply parses tab-separated integers with no shape, range, or type validation before passing features to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is present that checks model output probabilities for NaN, out-of-range values, or applies sanity bounds before returning predictions.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses classical ML models (XGBoost, AdaBoost, DecisionTree), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
